Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the N.H.A.I. and learned counsel for the State.
2. Present Writ application has been filed by the petitioner seeking direction to the Respondent to provide the solatium/compensation amounting Rs. 4,16,000/- per dismal on his four different lands mentioned in the Writ petition, acquired Patna High Court CWJC No. 291 of 2023(2) dt.20-06-2023 Subhash Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26990102/

Milkichak No.1, Anchal Sadar Munger, District-Munger were prepared.

sentences.text: 3. Counsel for N.H.A.I submits that according to the statute of National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) the remedy available to the petitioner is before the arbitrator and in the present matter the Commissioner, Bhagalpur is the arbitrator relating to such types of dispute for N.H.-80.

4. Counsel for the State agrees on the argument of counsel for the N.H.A.I.
5.

In the present facts and circumstances, under Section 3G(5) of the N.H. Act, 1956, the petitioner is directed to file his representation before the Commissioner, Bhagalpur in the nature of statement of claim, within four weeks from today.
6. It is also directed that the arbitrator shall decide on the statement of claim of the petition within 8 months.
7. With the aforesaid direction, this writ petition is hereby disposed off.

(Dr. Anshuman, J.) Ashishsingh/-
